about: The agent's readings of the sample work items (summary.test.mjs). One reading (Smart Toe II) is deliberately older than its feedback, to test the stale flag.

variant:columns:media-text.summary: Two reviewers on two pages find the image side of Media + text too small, one finds the gap too wide; both point at the variant's column split, not at single pages.

themes.title: Image column too narrow compared with the live page
themes.action: Measure the image share on the live pages and widen the image column of media-text (one rule for all 823 instances).

themes.title: Gap between image and text too wide
themes.action: Check the column gap token of media-text together with the image width change.

questions: Should wide-first become the default split for media-text instead of a per-block choice?

variant:cards-corp:resources.summary: Both rows are on blocks a reviewer switched from teaser to resources: the resources design does not carry teaser content well yet.

themes.title: Card titles too heavy
themes.action: Compare the resources title weight with the conventions; Bold titles may need the regular weight in this design.

themes.title: Switched cards don't line up with the resources next to them
themes.action: Align the card grid of resources when teaser content (longer text, image) is in it.

themes.title: Serif title text set approved on this page
themes.action: No change; note it against the open disagreement on the serif title group.

conversion:columns:feature-statement.summary: A trademark sign lost in the conversion: likely every page where the product name carries ™ / ®.

themes.title: Trademark sign missing after the product name
themes.action: Check the text pass of rules/variants.js for dropped <sup> ™ / ®; count the affected pages before fixing.

page:/us/en/foot-and-ankle/products/smar.summary: Read before the feedback came in (stale on purpose).
